title: Smart Lotteries in School Choice: Ex-ante Pareto-Improvement with Ex-post Stability
abstract: arXiv:2602.10679v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In school choice, students typically have strict preferences over the schools while the schools have coarse priorities over the students based on their distance and their enrolled siblings. The outcome of a centralized admission mechanism is then usually obtained by the Deferred Acceptance (DA) algorithm with random tie-breaking. Therefore, every outcome of this mechanism that occurs with a positive probability is a stable solution for the coarse priorities. This implies a probabilistic assignment, specifying the admission probability for each student-school pair. In this paper, we propose a new efficiency-improving stable 'smart lottery' mechanism. We aim to improve the probabilistic assignment ex-ante in a stochastic dominance sense, while ensuring that the improved random matching is still ex-post stable, meaning that it can be decomposed into stable matchings regarding the original coarse priorities. translated_title: 学校选择中的智能抽签：事前帕累托改进与事后稳定性
translated_abstract: 在学校选择问题中，学生通常对学校有严格的偏好，而学校则基于学生的居住距离和已入学的兄弟姐妹情况对学生拥有粗略的优先级。集中式录取机制的结果通常通过带随机打破平局的延迟接受算法（DA）获得。因此，该机制中每个以正概率出现的结果，对于粗略优先级而言都是一个稳定解。这意味着一种概率分配，即确定了每个学生-学校对的录取概率。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的提升效率且保持稳定的“智能抽签”机制。我们旨在以随机占优的意义在事前改进概率分配，同时确保改进后的随机匹配在事后仍然是稳定的，也就是说，它可以被分解为若干个关于原始粗略优先级的稳定匹配。因此，这种智能抽……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种“智能抽签”机制，在保证事后稳定性（可分解为原始粗略优先级下的稳定匹配）的同时，以随机占优的方式在事前帕累托改进学校选择中的学生录取概率分配。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a "smart lottery" mechanism that ex-ante improves the probabilistic assignment in school choice in the sense of stochastic dominance (Pareto improvement), while ensuring ex-post stability by decomposing into stable matchings under the original coarse priorities.
